source:
@@U00313@@
And he will get out! Aid him, if aid you may! He’s done us before today Great pleasures and rare! Help him, then, in his despair!

@@U00315@@
First to encounter the beast, ll use the Incantation of the Four.

@@U00316@@
(He reads from the conjurer’s book.)

@@U00317@@
Salamander, glow, Undine, coil, Sylph, disappear, Goblin, toil! He who knows not the four Elements, their power, their potencies, will never master the spirit world. Vanish in flame, Salamander! Flow swirling together, Watery Undines! Burn like meteors, Sylphs of the air! Bring housely help, Incubus, Incubus! Come forth And make an end! None of the four is in the beast. Look at him there, quietly grinning! I haven't yet harmed the brute at his core. But now I'll conjure with a mightier spell.

@@U00318@@
(He shows the beast a magic sign.)
translation:
@@U00313@@
他会出去的！如果你可以的话，请帮助他！他今天之前已经给我们带来了巨大的乐趣和罕见的！那么，在他绝望的时候帮助他吧！

@@U00315@@
首先遇到野兽，会使用四咒。

@@U00316@@
（他读的是魔术师的书。）

@@U00317@@
火蜥蜴、发光、温蒂娜、线圈、西尔芙、消失、哥布林、辛劳！不了解四种元素、它们的力量、它们的效力的人，永远无法掌握精神世界。消失在火焰中吧，火蜥蜴！水流一起旋转，水汪汪的！像流星一样燃烧，空气精灵！带来家政帮手，梦魇，梦魇！出来并结束吧！这四个人都没有在兽中。瞧他那儿，静静地笑！我还没有伤害到他内心深处的野蛮人。但现在我要施展更强大的咒语。

@@U00318@@
（他向野兽展示了一个魔法标志。）
